_meta.description: The hayabusa model (the EVTX detection engine on the detections lane): its Details and ExtraFieldInfo trees vary per rule, so both are flattened — one mapper each, whatever keys a rule emits. The rule severity rides the cross-lane Level backstop in logs-dxdfir@settings; the underlying Windows event that a hit was raised from is projected onto the shared logs-dxdfir@winlog model.
